subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` now with this doctor migration, or keep the config contract open until real gRPC exporters are implemented?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it deliberately changes a shipped config contract and disables enabled legacy OTLP-signal configs during doctor repair, which is a product/upgrade policy choice.

options.title: Accept strict config with doctor repair
options.body: Merge after maintainer approval of the compatibility behavior because the PR preserves the prior no-export outcome and gives operators an explicit repair path.

options.title: Keep grpc and implement exporters
options.body: Reject or pause this PR if maintainers want `grpc` to remain a supported config value and prefer adding real gRPC exporter dependencies and tests.

options.title: Defer the contract change
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for more upgrade proof if maintainers are not ready to change shipped config validation in this release train.

recommendation.title: Accept strict config with doctor repair
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer approval of the compatibility behavior because the PR preserves the prior no-export outcome and gives operators an explicit repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics OTel exporter/config surface traces to `steipete`, and this decision is about the long-term config contract for that feature.
